title: fix: capture Shopify fulfillment deliveredAt timestamp
summary: The Shopify connector now captures and displays the fulfillment delivery timestamp from Shopify, enabling users to see when shipments were actually delivered. A new field stores the deliveredAt value, the GraphQL query requests it, and the import logic parses it across both order fetches and shipment exports.
key_points: Added deliveredAt field to Shpfy Order Fulfillment table
Updated GraphQL query to request deliveredAt timestamp from Shopify
Import logic now parses and stores the delivered timestamp
Delivered At value displayed on Order Fulfillment pages
Handles both null values and re-import scenarios with timestamp updates
